dataList.content: Please show this screen to a staff member at the venue. A staff member will input the verification code. Please note that, should you verify this account on your own, it cannot be re-verified at the venue. This means that you will not be able to receive the entrance bracelet at the venue or enter the concert hall itself.

Unless this verification process is handled by an on-site staff member, you will not be able to receive the entrance bracelet or enter the concert hall.
